subject: Transportation Systems
title: The Fuxing Trains
description: A 1-minute de-risking session on The Fuxing Trains.

hook.text: China initially licensed technology from Japan and Europe. Then it built its own trains from scratch.

buildup.text: The Fuxing series entered service in 2017, designed entirely by Chinese engineers.

discovery.text: Fuxing trains cruise at 217 mph in daily service—the fastest scheduled trains in the world.

twist.text: Critics accused China of reverse-engineering foreign designs. China insists on independent innovation.

climax.text: Regardless of origin, the Fuxing fleet now exports globally, competing with Japan and Europe for contracts.

punchline.text: China learned from others, then built something its own.
